newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services to open Michigan facility.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services to open Michigan facility.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said Monday it has entered into an agreement to operate a juvenile facility in Michigan for about $7 million a year in revenues.
The Michigan Jobs Commission has approved a community development block grant of $750,000 to help renovate the facility at the former Calumet Air Force Station in Keweenaw County, the company said.
The company said the new facility will create 200 jobs when it is fully operational.
The project, which is called Keweenaw Academy, will serve about 200 young men. It is expected to open by January 1, 1997.
The company also said that Gary Bennett, a former executive director of Youth Services' Chamberlain Academy in South Dakota, has been named executive director of the Michigan facility.
